identity_reason: a flex row has no form of its own
concept: A row or column with a gap from the scale and both alignments named, so the ends of a row are placed by the system and never by margins.

root.why: a row or column whose spacing is a gap, never a margin

row.why: items side by side, so the layout reads the same everywhere it is used

column.why: items one under another, so the layout reads the same everywhere it is used

wrap.why: items move to a new line rather than overflow
